text: Atheo Ingénierie SAS (SIREN 795151885, RCS Strasbourg) is a SAS whose président is OCI, a Grenoble SAS (SIREN 838798163, 5 rue d'Alsace 38000 Grenoble) led by Marc Rebouah; no state or fund shareholder identified in the chain.
short: Atheo Ingénierie is held via OCI, a private Grenoble holding (Marc Rebouah).
